alerts.title: it is so fatiguing having to ban Dino , Gambit , elsa , Phoenix , Hela , bucky, Peni etc etc EVERY GAME. It is not fun to have to repat the same bans or your game quality is unbearable and you just want to surrender so you don't have to play against these characters.
alerts.summary: It has been soo many seasons of the same few characters needing to be permanently banned. Can we please nerf these same repeat offenders. it is fine if elsa peni gambit etc are unplayable for a season or 2 if they don't know how to balance them. These characters aren't just overpowered they are tiringly broken and it's not fun to play into them. submitted by /u/DannyDevitoisalegend to r/marvelrivals [link] [comments]
